name: vore is death 2: brain leak
source:
Isn't life so exhausting sometimes- to the end of your wits? Don't you ever wish you could throw away all your responsibilities and burden to someone who would take care of you?

Whether or not he sucks and slurps your soul right out of you hardly matters, right?

Choose from three girls and experience a variety of ways to run away from yourself on a night on the town! And good luck seeing if he'll ever let you go.

生活有时不就是这么让人疲惫不堪吗？难道你不曾希望能把所有的责任和负担都抛给一个能照顾你的人吗？

他是否会吸走你的灵魂并从你身上吸走并不重要，对吧？

从三个女孩中进行选择，体验在小镇之夜逃离自我的各种方式！祝你好运，看看他是否会放你走。
